blocks.text: Persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) cast their votes during the plebiscite in Naga City on Saturday, Nov. 21, on whether the city should be converted into a highly urbanized city. Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia said PDLs are entitled to participate in the plebiscite, as voting is among the rights they retain while in detention.
